hook.title: Make the AI ask *you* questions first

scenes.before: Write a workout plan for me.
scenes.after:
Write a workout plan for me.
Before you start, ask me up to 3 questions about anything you'd need to know.
scenes.title: Add *one* line
It finds what you *forgot*
scenes.body: Your goal, your schedule, your injuries. Things you'd never think to mention.

scenes.title: Anything *personal*
scenes.body: Plans, resumes, emails, budgets. Anywhere the right answer depends on you.

end.title: Save this *one*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
One line that makes almost any prompt better:

"Before you start, ask me up to 3 questions about anything you'd need to know."

Instead of guessing, it asks about the stuff you didn't think to mention. Best for anything where the right answer depends on you: plans, resumes, emails, budgets.
